item.title: Spruce to cease operations on January 31
item.description: After 20 years of operations, Spruce—the authorized dealer and sub-distributor of Havaianas in Northern and Western Mindanao—has announced it will cease operations effective January 31, 2026. The closure marks the end of the brand’s local retail presence under Spruce, which has long carried the popular Brazilian footwear known for its comfort and casual style. item.title: RANDOM SHOTS: Lightning strike kills horse, injures rider in Bukidnon
item.description: In a tragic irony during the Year of the Horse, a horse was killed after being struck by lightning, while its rider was rushed to the hospital. The incident occurred at around 3:20 p.m. on January 2, 2026, in Purok 17, Hindangon, Barangay Poblacion, Valencia City, Bukidnon.
